name: Settlement Instruction Query Criteria 4
definition: Defines the criteria based on which information is included.

References.name: References
References.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

SecuritiesTransactionType.name: Securities Transaction Type
SecuritiesTransactionType.definition: Identifies the type of securities transaction.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instruments representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account where financial instruments are maintained.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account in which cash is maintained.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid or received in exchange for the securities.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Date on which a transaction is expected to settle. That is, the intended day on which transfer of cash or assets is completed.

EffectiveSettlementDate.name: Effective Settlement Date
EffectiveSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which a transaction is completed and cleared, that is a payment is effected and securities are delivered.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency in which the instructed amount is expressed.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

CounterpartSettlementParties.name: Counterpart Settlement Parties
CounterpartSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of counterparty settlement parties.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

TradeTransactionCondition.name: Trade Transaction Condition
TradeTransactionCondition.definition: Provides the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

SecuritiesTransactionCondition.name: Securities Transaction Condition
SecuritiesTransactionCondition.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

ConditionalSecuritiesDelivery.name: Conditional Securities Delivery
ConditionalSecuritiesDelivery.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is under Conditional Securities Delivery (CoSD).

CountryOfIssue.name: Country Of Issue
CountryOfIssue.definition: Primary market or country where a security is issued by the issuer or its agent.

IssuerCSD.name: Issuer CSD
IssuerCSD.definition: Central securities depository (CSD) in which financial instruments are issued (or immobilised). The issuer CSD opens accounts allowing investors (in a direct holding system) and/or intermediaries (including investor CSDs) to hold these financial instruments.

HoldIndicator.name: Hold Indicator
HoldIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is on hold, blocked or frozen.
